baseline_study: v1 (commit ec27ad0), preserved unchanged as the negative baseline
stage_rationale: Stage A learned on development seeds, so the staged protocol stops at the simplest model that genuinely learns; stages B and C were not needed.
learning_rule: actor-critic e-prop: per-synapse eligibility traces, a learned scalar critic, TD error delta = r + gamma*V(s') - V(s), neuron-specific learning signals, entropy regularisation and an exploration floor
frozen_components: plasticity mask (stage A: recurrent core entirely frozen)
motor decoding (greedy softmax mode at evaluation)
training schedule (600 episodes, no early stopping)
seed_disjointness: v1.1 confirmatory seeds were never used in v1, nor in any v1.1 development or feature-fitting run; tests/test_v11.py asserts this

criteria: training success improves from the first to the last fifth of training
held-out greedy success exceeds the random policy by more than 0.05 on every seed
action choice remains state-dependent: state_dependence > 0.05 and final action entropy > 0.1

topology_test: eprop on the biological graph versus the degree-preserving rewired graph, with identical learning rule, neuron count, readout architecture, training budget and per-graph standardisation procedure
inference: exploratory three-seed descriptive bootstrap; no confirmatory p-values
resource_guard: 120 s per independently guarded trial, no parallel workers, no raised limits
